policies.nativeCore: All six capabilities work with native tenant-owned configuration, registries and HRM/Auth owner APIs. Optional connectors only import/export with explicit receipts; no connector prerequisite for native create, query, lifecycle, eligibility or SLA.
policies.externalActivation: Country packs, insurer/ATS/vendor connectors and customer production approval remain G6 activation blockers, not prerequisites for generic G3 design.
policies.identity: Public UUIDs are opaque IDs, never derived from businessKey, displayName, a different path UUID or X-Correlation-ID. SQL identities stay local tenant BIGINT. Codes remain typed strings. Snapshot/version references must be owner-issued immutable UUIDs with domain, tenant, scope, effective-time and digest proofs.
policies.correlation: X-Correlation-ID may bind only correlation_id / event envelope correlationId. It is forbidden for every business FK/reference, code, state, task or eligibility input.
policies.commands: Closed typed request schema; Idempotency-Key replay is scoped tenant+principal+operation+canonical payload. Changed-payload replay fails 409. Existing aggregate changes require If-Match; parent version and task/offer ownership checked in one owner transaction.
policies.references: Explicit request refs resolve through tenant-scoped owner query/command contracts. Local lookup SELECT tenant_id+public_id yields the corresponding table internal id only. Existing unrelated refs are loaded/preserved, not overwritten from path. Cross-boundary data access, DB joins, repositories and SQL FKs remain forbidden.
policies.sensitiveData: Candidate/dependent/person data tokenized in privacy vault; documents use typed authorized immutable object references. No protected attribute or raw secret in events. Digests are computed integrity evidence, not the only mutation driver.
policies.effectiveTime: Owner transaction clock is authoritative. Explicit business effective dates validated against pinned timezone/calendar and config validity; no silent latest-version fallback. No fixed legal retention duration in core.
policies.events: Transactional outbox after successful atomic owner write; actual aggregate type/publicId/version. v2 domain-specific payloads replace conflated v1 events in a new materialized contract; historical event bytes remain unchanged.
policies.queryProjection: Typed tenant-filtered SELECT projection, keyset cursor and scope revision from owner read transaction; never fabricate table.items / next_cursor / has_more / as_of columns.
policies.approval: Receipts are owner-authenticated snapshots binding tenant, aggregate publicId, proposed revision, digest, decision and effective time. Maker/checker enforced where policy requires; approval UUID alone is not evidence.
policies.workerProposal: Only HRM worker command owner creates/updates canonical Worker. Proposal request is not a Worker ID. Candidate HIRED / contingent ACTIVE requires an accepted owner receipt containing actual workerPublicId and proposal linkage.
policies.materialization: New API/event/schema/table versions require coordinated contract materialization, authorization register, migration allocation, BE/FE implementation and acceptance evidence. This delta does not advance a gate.

typedSourceContract.ownerBoundary: Planned exact authoritative DTO/SPI/response/source bindings require canonical common adapters and independent oracle extension G3. Validator v1 cannot prove ownerResponse/nested leaf identity and must FAIL. Complete business endpoints/projections/migrations/native journeys are G4; actual customer identity bootstrap/adoption authority G6. Labels cannot produce PASS.

Existing elections retain pinned version; new election blocked after retirement, no silent cross-version substitution.

Resolve selfContext only under signed tenant/principal. Submitted dependent tokens must belong to selected self worker with purpose authorization; query eligibility must be re-evaluated in submit transaction. | Do not accept a digest-only election; policy, plan, option, dependents, effective date and eligibility provenance drive write. | Transition-specific: selected version belongs to benefitPlanId and is published/effective; eligible; election window or verified active life event; no conflicting overlapping election

Cancel native election locally; if provider fulfillment exists create cancellation execution separately and expose unreconciled status. No claim that external coverage is canceled before receipt. | Transition-specific: self window permits cancellation or authorized reviewer receipt; effectiveDate > effective_from

No hard-coded country benefit program. Typed evidence/document policy is actual business input; sourceRecordKey remains string scoped worker. | Transition-specific: self context active; allowed type; occurrence within configured submission period; immutable evidence verified

Verified life event can authorize only matching self worker/type/date/plan window; no digest-only verification. | Transition-specific: decision VERIFY; actual evidence valid; reviewer independent; compute configured enrollment window
Verified life event can authorize only matching self worker/type/date/plan window; no digest-only verification. | Transition-specific: decision REJECT; actual owner verification receipt

Expiry does not erase history or fabricate provider outcomes; invalidates future special enrollment only. | Transition-specific: owner time beyond evidence/submission/window deadline per pinned policy

domainRules: Plan identity owns immutable effective versions with explicit eligibility/window policy UUIDs and typed coverage definitions.

Eligibility actually evaluates pinned policy against worker/dependent snapshots, coverage limits, effective date and enrollment window; query and submit return/store the same input/result provenance.
Life event requires immutable evidence, verification decision and window computation before it can enable special enrollment. Expired or rejected event cannot authorize enrollment.

Native ACTIVE means authorized local election; optional insurer execution is tracked separately and never fabricated. Provider-enabled plans expose external fulfillment status without redefining election ACTIVE.

assignmentCompletionStatus.algorithm: Under locked assignment, if COUNT(required AND status NOT IN (COMPLETED,WAIVED)) == 0 return COMPLETED else IN_PROGRESS. Valid waiver receipts must already be verified; cancel optional PENDING siblings only upon COMPLETED.

assignmentCompletedAt.algorithm: Return ownerClock.now only if final assignment state COMPLETED; otherwise NULL. Never use arbitrary client timestamp as assignment terminal receipt.

assignmentNextRevision.algorithm: Checked BIGINT +1 under parent optimistic lock; replay does not increment.

taskPostMutationStatus.algorithm: Exact authorized path task becomes COMPLETED for complete or WAIVED for waive; optional PENDING sibling becomes CANCELLED only if assignment completes; all other sibling rows unchanged.

taskCompletionRevision.algorithm: MAX(completion_revision)+1 for locked exact assignment/task; first is 1; duplicate command returns original receipt.

taskDueAt.algorithm: For selected exact task definition add dueOffsetBusinessDays using pinned calendar and worker timezone; dueAt=min(task computed deadline, assignment dueAt); reject deadline before assignment.

nextScenarioRevision.algorithm: First new scenario revision 1; otherwise MAX(parent-scoped revision_no)+1 under locked scenario. Never copy scenario publicId into revision FK.

workforceSnapshotManifest.algorithm: Owner-refetch each exact pinned snapshot/rule; verify asOf/org scope, record owner digests plus canonical typed line digest. No latest lookup.

workforceSimulationResult.algorithm: FTE_TIMES_UNIT_COST_V1: validate line facts against manifest; per currency sum targetFte*unitCost, never mix currencies; round per pinned LINE/CURRENCY_TOTAL rule using HALF_EVEN/HALF_UP and declared scale; sum FTE at configured scale. Seed is validated replay provenance, not pseudo-random staffing choice. Sorted canonical line order and rule/input digests produce stable resultDigest; expose violations. Record exact intermediate and posted before/after quantization stages, mode/scale/policy digest; obey authoritative decimal-value-types.v1.json, no implicit SQL rounding.

workforceCanonicalProposals.algorithm: Map approved line impacts to POSITION_CAPACITY_CHANGE / PLANNED_REQUISITION / NO_CHANGE proposal per owner policy. Every line carries scenario/revision/resultDigest/effectiveDate and applicationStatus PROPOSED. No direct canonical DB mutation.

benefitEligibilityResult.algorithm: Fetch exact plan policy and effective worker/dependent snapshots under self context. Evaluate closed ALL clauses on employmentStatus/workerType/FTE/serviceDays/dependent count; verify option allowed, token ownership, dependent limits and window. Store snapshot/policy/version inputDigest and resultDigest, eligible flag and exact reasonCodes. Query/submit use same evaluator; submit re-fetches.

lifeEventWindowUntil.algorithm: VERIFY computes min(verified policy business-calendar window after event/verification milestone, evidence expiry); REJECT returns NULL. Store policy calendar and owner verification proof; no hard-coded legal duration.

caseActionSequence.algorithm: Parent-locked MAX(action_sequence)+1; first action1; one typed action per new command; replay no additional action.

caseNextRevision.algorithm: Locked aggregate version +1 checked BIGINT; response/receipt/events use actual UPDATE RETURNING version.

clockNextRevision.algorithm: Clock revision +1 under case lock; replay stable.

slaInitialDueAt.algorithm: Add budgetBusinessSeconds to intake ownerClock using selected calendar timezone, weekdays, opening intervals, holidays and DST rules. Reject unsupported/invalid calendar version.

measuredBusinessSeconds.algorithm: RUNNING: accumulated + calendar business seconds in [active_since,ownerClock.now). PAUSED: accumulated unchanged. Checked BIGINT, never negative, no wall-clock shortcut. Calculation happens before clock state/timestamp update.

slaResumedDueAt.algorithm: Remaining=max(0,budget-accumulated); add remaining business seconds from owner now using same calendar. If already breached retain breach outcome; never reset accumulated.

slaOutcome.algorithm: PAUSE milestone => PAUSED with actual elapsed/breach provenance; RESOLUTION/CANCELLATION/RESUME => BREACHED iff elapsed > budget else MET. EXEMPT only explicit pinned policy exemption proof, not caller label.

clockIntervalFrom.algorithm: RUNNING uses active_since; PAUSED uses paused_since with zero incremental business time; interval_to ownerClock. Always retain prior accumulated value.

typedCaseActionPayload.algorithm: Serialize exact operation's closed request variant plus action=operationId, final case revision, pinned policy digest and actor proof. Include actual assignee/content/citation/pause/resolve fields, not a caller-only digest.

checkedAccessGrantRequest.algorithm: GRANT validates active engagement and exact roles/resources/product scope; every expiry <= engagement/access expiry. REVOKE uses verified current engagement grant inventory, not caller invented grants. RETRY_REVOKE covers unresolved predecessor inventory. Persist closed GRANT or REVOKE union items; REVOKE contains actual grantPublicId/grantRevision from inventory, not role request objects.

verifiedAuthReceipt.algorithm: Auth owner re-fetch verifies callerRequestId, command UUID, engagement/worker, inventory revision, grant IDs/revisions/outcomes/expiry and digest. Body assertions must exactly equal proof.

accessReconciliationState.algorithm: CONFIRMED iff latest owner receipt succeeds; RETRY_REQUIRED for unresolved partial receipt; RECONCILED only empty verified current inventory and all failed attempts covered by accepted exact successor. Preserve failed history.

benefitProviderPayload.algorithm: Export actual election/version/coverage/date and purpose-tokenized worker using enabled optional provider profile. Native mode does not execute/export or fabricate external receipt; SYS allocates actual execution UUID.

knowledgeExcerptDigest.algorithm: Fetch exact immutable native article document section through document owner; verify hash/purpose; apply pinned deterministic redaction, hash authorized excerpt. Store actual retrieval receipt tied to case/agent/version/section. No arbitrary citation UUID or synthetic digest.

citationProvenanceDigest.algorithm: For each exact response citation, tenant-re-fetch native article version and access receipt; verify case/agent/purpose/sourceVersion/section/excerpt/redaction match, preserve snapshot version+receipt IDs. Hash canonical sorted typed citation proofs plus response contentDigest/retention policy; original human response hashes explicit HUMAN_ORIGINAL provenance. No arbitrary UUID refs or unsupported answer source.

enrollmentEligibilityDigest.algorithm: Extract validated EligibilityResult.resultDigest from stored exact schema; revalidate schema and policy/worker/plan refs, do not recompute from arbitrary blob.

caseBusinessYear.algorithm: EXTRACT year from authoritative owner local business date; bounded INTEGER year.

nextCaseBusinessNumber.algorithm: Under tenant+calendar-year advisory lock or serializable owner transaction compute MAX(allocation_no)+1, first1; unique constraints enforce. Replay reuses allocation; full intake rollback removes allocation.

formattedCaseNumber.algorithm: Format HRC-YYYY-<12-digit business allocation_no>; reject overflow per explicit code policy. Never UUID, trace ID or SQL internal row ID.
